question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, and the average subject enrollment number in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by department code and ordered by total units, along with the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in library subjects that have a matching master subject ID in the TIP subject offerings for the same department (considering only departments with more than 0 enrolled students in both tables). Additionally, for each such department, show the maximum number of enrolled students in any library subject for that department. List the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, term description, total units, windowed average subject enrollment number, library students variance, library students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the maximum number of enrolled students in library subjects for the department, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.

= '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_variance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), subject_window AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects, AVG(sw.window_column) AS avg_subject_enrollment FROM subject_window AS sw LEFT JOIN dept_variance AS dv ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, catalog_key_variance, num_subjects, avg_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_subject_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) ORDER BY avg_subject_enrollment DESC, catalog_key_variance DESC

WITH dept_variance AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY catalog_key_variance DESC), subject_window AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.catalog_key_variance, sw.SUBJECT_CODE, sw.SUBJECT_NUMBER, sw.SUBJECT_TITLE, sw.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sw.TOTAL_UNITS, sw.window_column FROM subject_window AS sw LEFT JOIN dept_variance AS dv ON sw.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dv.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dv.catalog_key_variance DESC, sw.TOTAL_UNITS DESC

WITH ChemistrySubjects AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TERM_CODE, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, cs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.SUBJECT_CODE, cs.max_enrolled_students, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev FROM ChemistrySubjects AS cs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON cs.join_dept_name = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH chem_subjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC) SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_enrolled_students, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.enrolled_students_variance, d.enrolled_students_stddev FROM chem_subjects AS c LEFT JOIN dept_enrollment_stats AS d ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY c.max_enrolled_students DESC, d.enrolled_students_variance DESC

  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccs.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND ccs.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
    AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS = 12
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT
    b.SUBJECT_CODE,
    b.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    b.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    b.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    b.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    b.TOTAL_UNITS,
    b.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    AVG(b.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.DEPARTMENT_CODE
      ORDER BY b.TOTAL_UNITS
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS windowed_avg_enrollment
  FROM base b
),
matched_library AS (
  SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso
      WHERE tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
        AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
        AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
    )
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_variance,
    STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS library_stddev,
    MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_library_enrollment
  FROM matched_library
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE
)
SELECT
  w.SUBJECT_CODE,
  w.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
  w.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  w.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  w.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  w.TOTAL_UNITS,
  w.windowed_avg_enrollment,
  ds.library_variance,
  ds.library_stddev,
  ds.max_library_enrollment
FROM windowed w
JOIN dept_stats ds ON w.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY w.TOTAL_UNITS
